zechariah-prophet.name: Zechariah, son of Berechiah
zechariah-prophet.role: Prophet named in the opening and dated messages
zechariah-prophet.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
zechariah-prophet.importance: His questions make the visions’ explanations part of the account rather than assumed knowledge.
zechariah-prophet.connections: The opening names Berechiah as his father and Iddo as his grandfather.

zerubbabel.name: Zerubbabel
zerubbabel.role: Governor addressed in the promise to finish the house
zerubbabel.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
zerubbabel.importance: The same hands must lay the foundation and finish the work despite small beginnings.
zerubbabel.connections: He is the governor also addressed by Haggai during the rebuilding.

jeshua-priest.name: Joshua, son of Jehozadak
jeshua-priest.role: High priest restored in one vision and crowned in another
jeshua-priest.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
jeshua-priest.importance: Changed clothing shows removed wrongdoing, while his future service still requires obedience.
jeshua-priest.connections: He is Jehozadak’s son, the high priest also addressed in Haggai.

darius-ezra.name: Darius, the Persian king
darius-ezra.role: Persian king whose regnal years date the opening messages
darius-ezra.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
darius-ezra.importance: His second and fourth regnal years supply time references without dating the later visions.
darius-ezra.connections: He is the Persian king also named in Haggai and Ezra.
